ImageDescription.value: Waves crashing up through the boardwalk during Storm Ciara 2020 in the north harbour, Lysekil, Sweden. During the storm, sea levels along the west coast of Sweden were the highest in 34 years, in some areas as high as 137 cm (54 in) above average. In this photo, the sea is about 100 cm (39 in) above average with wind speed at 22 m/s (49 mph).
